css: .lx-native-pos{width:74mm;max-width:74mm;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:10px;color:#000;margin:0;padding:0}.lx-rh{text-align:center;margin-bottom:5px}.lx-logo{max-height:36px;max-width:54mm;margin-bottom:4px}.lx-shop{font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.lx-small{font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.3}.lx-label{font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px}.lx-info div,.lx-row,.lx-pay{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:7px}.lx-items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}.lx-items th{text-align:left;border-bottom:1px dashed #000;padding:3px 0}.lx-items td{padding:4px 0;vertical-align:top}.lx-items th:nth-child(n+2),.lx-items td:nth-child(n+2){text-align:right}.lx-items td:first-child{width:45%;word-break:break-word}.lx-code{font-size:8px;color:#555}.lx-total{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;padding:4px 0}.lx-fbr{text-align:center}.lx-fbr-logo{max-width:47mm;max-height:16mm;margin:3px auto}.lx-qr{display:block;width:25.4mm;height:25.4mm;margin:5px auto}.lx-banner{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;border:2px solid #000;padding:5px;margin:5px 0}.lx-footer{text-align:center;font-size:9px;margin-top:7px}hr{border:none;border-top:1px dashed #000;margin:6px 0}@media screen{.print-format{box-sizing:border-box;width:80mm!important;max-width:80mm!important;min-height:0!important;padding:3mm!important}}@media print{@page{size:80mm auto;margin:3mm}body{margin:0;padding:0}.print-format{min-height:0!important;padding:0!important}}
